rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hi everyone, and welcome
to the militia camp!

rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Here, people from different countries
and social standings live together
under one roof! Well, one tent.

rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0003
rows.name:
This was Adel-sama's idea! At first we
stuck with people from our own
countries, but he said it wouldn't do.

rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0004
rows.name:
At first we fought too, but each time
Adel-sama stepped in, and we learned
to speak honestly with each other...

rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Now we care more about who snores
at night than who's from where!

rows.label: tlk70000053_01_msg0006
rows.name:
Adel-sama knew this would happen
when he told us to live together properly.
He's amazing. I admire him!
